notes: Investor-owned (its funds own the firm): no shares, no stock price, no SEC 10-K, so no rating or target price

BLK.implication: Vanguard sets the price floor in index funds, so BlackRock's index fees stay under pressure; BlackRock's growth case rests on areas Vanguard barely competes in: private markets (GIP, HPS), active ETFs and Aladdin technology.
